title: Harden Transcript Cleaning output validation
description: Preserve locally removed formatting noise in the cleaning artifact and reject materially unchanged long model outputs.
businessContext: Long transcript cleaning must preserve an auditable record of local normalization and fail closed when a provider returns no meaningful cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Formatting noise removed before provider execution is persisted as removedSegments with reason formatting_noise.
A long provider response that changes only an insignificant number of characters fails closed with output_content_invalid.
Existing Transcript Cleaning focused tests remain green.
